description: Shared candidate matrix for SSH engine spike. Every candidate receives every test id.

tests.description: Record version, repository, license, feature/backend and release provenance.
Build or link the candidate using the supported local path.
Verify the candidate exposes a server host-key verification callback or equivalent policy hook.
Verify public-key/password/agent authentication API surface is discoverable.
Verify non-interactive command execution API or system client path.
Verify session channel, PTY or interactive stream API surface.
Verify SFTP and local/remote forwarding API surface or system capability.
Verify timeout, disconnect, cancellation or non-blocking operation controls are exposed.
Record a repeatable local wall-clock smoke measurement for the candidate path; daemon throughput remains a separate interoperability gate.
Scan captured logs and report artifacts for forbidden secret-like values.
